news.title: SpaceX IPO引发华尔街对AI繁荣是否泡沫的争论，双方各有道理
news.snippet: SpaceX上市计划引发市场对AI泡沫辩论，投资者权衡高增长潜力与估值风险。
news.raw_snippet: 3. Best money market accounts. On June 12, **SpaceX** (NASDAQ: SPCX) completed the largest initial public offering (IPO) in history, raising about $75 billion at a valuation of about $1.75 trillion -- more than double the size of any stock market debut before it. SpaceX went public in the middle of a wave of artificial intelligence (AI) spending unlike anything the market has seen, with the four biggest technology companies alone on track to pour about $725 billion into capital expenditures (much of it on data centers and chips this year) -- up about 77% from last year. To some investors, a record listing landing on top of all that spending looks like the kind of enthusiasm that shows up near market tops. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. The *Motley Fool Stock Advisor* analyst team just identified what they believe are the **10 best stocks** for investors to buy now… and Alphabet wasn’t one of them.
